title: Rick Doty sent to collect the witnesses' medical records
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base flight surgeon's office, South Dakota

tellings.quote: he was brought in to go over sent over to the flight surgeon's office to pick up our medical records

plain: In 1977, after an incident at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, a man named Rick Doty is said to have been sent to the base flight surgeon's office to pick up the medical records of the guards involved. Mario Woods, a former nuclear weapons guard who says he was abducted, tells Michels this, citing Doty and a man named Michael Johnson. If true, it would mean someone moved quickly to take control of the witnesses' records.
